For "build a house" use small_house (cozy 5x5 wooden house: log corners, pitched stair roof, windows, door, torches, crafting table, chest, bed if there is wool). Others: cottage (bigger 7x7 house on a cobblestone foundation with porch, glass windows, furnace), cabin (log cabin), watchtower (ladder, fenced platform), fortress (15x15 walled compound to put a house in), hut (plain box, quick), shelter (emergency 3x3 box around the bot), wall_segment, platform, tower. Picks a flat, clear spot near whoever asked (never in protected areas or over player builds), fills small dips, digs bumps and plants, faces the door to the player (or an open side), places blocks with the right facing (stairs, slabs, logs, doors, torches...), checks every block afterwards and fixes mistakes, and skips blocks that are already right, so calling it again resumes an interrupted build. gather=true first gathers what is missing. catalog.description: Say something in public chat.

catalog.name: come
catalog.description: Walk to a player (default: whoever asked).

player.description: player name; defaults to the requesting player

catalog.name: follow
catalog.description: Follow a player, staying close, until stopped.

player.description: player name; defaults to the requesting player

distance.description: how close to stay, in blocks

catalog.name: goto
catalog.description: Walk to block coordinates, any distance (long trips go in legs and can take minutes; it keeps going in the background until it arrives, gets stuck or is stopped). Omit y to go to the surface at x/z.

catalog.name: goto_player
catalog.description: Walk to where a player currently is (one-off, does not keep following).

catalog.name: look_at
catalog.description: Turn to look at a player.

catalog.name: jump
catalog.description: Jump once.

catalog.name: attack
catalog.description: Fight the most dangerous hostile mob nearby, or a specific entity by id. Never attacks players, villagers, golems, pets or named mobs.

entityId.description: entity id; default the most dangerous hostile mob nearby

radius.description: how far to look for a target, in blocks

catalog.name: guard
catalog.description: Stay near a player and kill hostile mobs that come close to them, until stopped.

player.description: player to protect; defaults to the requesting player

catalog.name: hunt
catalog.description: Hunt passive animals (cow, pig, sheep, chicken, rabbit, mooshroom) for food and pick up the drops. Never touches pets, named, tamed or leashed animals, babies, villagers or players, and by default leaves fenced animals alone.

animal.description: which animal; default the nearest huntable one

count.description: how many to kill

radius.description: how far to look, in blocks

pens.description: also hunt animals inside fences (only your own farm)

keepAtLeast.description: leave at least this many adults of each kind alive (sustainable herd)

reach.description: when an animal is out of reach on foot, bridge, pillar (up to 16 blocks of dirt, cobblestone or planks) or dig to it, never in protected areas or danger zones

catalog.name: gear_up
catalog.description: Put on the best armour in the inventory and put a totem of undying or a shield in the offhand.

catalog.name: eat
catalog.description: Eat the best food in the inventory.

catalog.name: sleep
catalog.description: Sleep in a bed within 16 blocks (only works at night or during storms).

catalog.name: wake
catalog.description: Get out of bed.

catalog.name: pillar
catalog.description: Emergency escape: jump and place blocks underneath to stand on a pillar out of reach of mobs. Uses dirt/cobblestone/planks from the inventory.

item.description: block to use; default the most plentiful dirt/cobblestone/planks

catalog.name: climb_out
catalog.description: Get out of a pit, shaft or cave straight up to open sky: dig the block above if needed, jump and place a block underneath, repeat. Without blocks it carves stair steps up into the wall instead.

maxBlocks.description: give up after rising this many blocks

catalog.name: bunker
catalog.description: Hide from phantoms and other mobs: dig straight down 3 blocks, seal the hole above with a dug block, wait until morning (or until no hostiles are near), then climb out. Needs digging; not in protected areas.

maxMinutes.description: give up waiting after this long

untilDay.description: stay until morning instead of until mobs leave

catalog.name: inventory
catalog.description: List what the bot is carrying.

catalog.name: drop
catalog.description: Throw items towards the requesting player (or on the ground). item="all" drops everything.

item.description: item name, or "all"

count.description: how many; default the whole stack(s)

catalog.name: equip
catalog.description: Hold an item in the main hand.

catalog.name: wander
catalog.description: Take a short walk to a random spot within a radius of home (or of a given center, or of where the bot stands).

radius.description: how far from the center to wander, in blocks

x.description: center x; default home, else current position

catalog.name: set_home
catalog.description: Remember a home position (default: where the bot stands now).

catalog.name: go_home
catalog.description: Walk back to the remembered home position.

range.description: how close to get, in blocks

catalog.name: remember_place
catalog.description: Remember a named place (default: where the bot stands now), to walk back to later with goto_place.

catalog.name: forget_place
catalog.description: Forget a named place.

catalog.name: places
catalog.description: List home and remembered places.

catalog.name: goto_place
catalog.description: Walk to a place remembered with remember_place.

catalog.name: flee
catalog.description: Run away from the nearest hostile mob until it is a safe distance away.

distance.description: how far to get from the mob

entityId.description: run from this mob instead of the nearest hostile one

catalog.name: craft
catalog.description: Craft an item from what is in the inventory. Uses a crafting table within 16 blocks when the recipe needs one, or puts one down (from the inventory, or made from planks).

item.description: item to make, e.g. stick, crafting_table, stone_pickaxe

count.description: how many items to end up with (not recipe runs)

catalog.name: smelt
catalog.description: Smelt items in a furnace within 32 blocks (or one placed from the inventory), add fuel, wait and take the results.

item.description: item to smelt, e.g. raw_iron, sand, oak_log

fuel.description: fuel item; default the best one in the inventory (coal, charcoal, planks, logs...)

catalog.name: deposit
catalog.description: Put items into the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). item="all" stores everything except tools, armour, food and anything in keep.

item.description: item name, or "all"

count.description: how many; default all of them

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

catalog.name: withdraw
catalog.description: Take items out of the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z).

item.description: item name, or "all" to empty the container

count.description: how many; default all of that item

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

catalog.name: list_container
catalog.description: Say what is inside the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). Looks inside if it is within reach and the bot is idle, otherwise reports what it saw last time.

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

catalog.name: harvest
catalog.description: Harvest ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot nearby (or within a radius of x y z, e.g. one field), pick up the drops and replant from the inventory.

radius.description: how far to look for crops, in blocks

x.description: centre of the field (with y and z); default where the bot stands

catalog.name: plant
catalog.description: Plant seeds (wheat_seeds, carrot, potato, beetroot_seeds) on empty farmland nearby.

seed.description: seed item; default whatever seeds the bot has

count.description: how many to plant at most

x.description: centre of the field (with y and z); default where the bot stands

catalog.name: till
catalog.description: Turn dirt or grass into farmland with a hoe, either at x y z or the nearest spots next to water. Needs digging enabled.

x.description: block to till; omit x/y/z to pick dirt near water

catalog.name: find_food
catalog.description: Scout for food beyond what is in sight: first known food spots, then an expanding spiral around home (or here) out to `radius` blocks, by day, avoiding water, lava and protected areas, until it sees huntable animals or a village farm. Remembers what it finds as places (food:animals, food:village_farm, food:water). Does not hunt; use hunt or keep_fed after.

radius.description: how far from home to scout, in blocks

crops.description: village farms (crops with villagers nearby) count as food too

keepAtLeast.description: only count animals above this many adults of a kind (a herd to spare)

from.description: centre of the search: home (when set) or where the bot stands

minRadius.description: skip rings at or inside this radius (an earlier, smaller search covered them)

seeds.description: pick up this many seeds on the way by breaking grass next to the path (for a farm later)

catalog.name: start_farm
catalog.description: Start a small farm of its own: picks grass or dirt by water near home (or a place), outside protected areas and away from anybody's builds or fields (or pours water from a bucket), then gets seeds by breaking grass (or uses carrots, potatoes, beetroot seeds), makes a hoe if needed, tills a plot around the water, plants it, fences and lights it if it has the materials, and remembers it as farm:1, farm:2... for farm_loop/farm_setup. Needs digging enabled.

place.description: remembered place (or home) to farm near; default home, else here

x.description: farm near this x (with z) instead

size.description: plot side, odd, around one water block (9 = 80 farmland)

radius.description: how far from the centre to look for water

seeds.description: seeds to collect before planting (breaks grass until it has them or gives up)

fence.description: fence the plot when it has (or can craft) enough fences

light.description: put torches on the corners when it has torches or coal

spawnClearance.description: never farm within this distance of the world spawn

catalog.name: tend_farm
catalog.description: Look after its own farm (farm:1, farm:2...): put the water back if it is gone (with a bucket), plant bare farmland, till trampled dirt again and plant it, and grow the plot a ring at a time towards `size` around its water with the seeds it has, keeping `seedReserve` seeds for replanting. Use harvest for ripe crops. Needs digging enabled for tilling.

size.description: side of the square to grow the farm towards (one water block keeps 9x9 wet)

seedReserve.description: seeds kept for replanting: new cells only from seeds beyond these

maxCells.description: cells to plant or till at most this run

spawnClearance.description: never till within this distance of the world spawn

catalog.name: gather_seeds
catalog.description: Get seeds for a farm by breaking grass and ferns nearby (wheat seeds drop about 1 in 8) and picking them up. Keeps going, patch by patch out to the radius, until it has the seeds, the time is up or the grass runs out. Skips protected areas and the world spawn. Needs digging enabled.

count.description: seeds to get

radius.description: how far to look for grass

spawnClearance.description: never break grass this close to the world spawn

catalog.name: forage
catalog.description: Stopgap food from what grows wild nearby: pick ripe sweet berries (the bush stays), cut kelp at the shore without diving (smelt it into dried kelp later), and with apples=true break oak and dark oak leaves for apples (about 1 in 200) and pick up apples lying around. Never on protected land.

radius.description: how far to look

max.description: bushes or kelp stalks to take at most

apples.description: also break leaves for apples (slow, low odds: a last resort)

leaves.description: leaves to break at most for apples

catalog.name: breed
catalog.description: Breed two adult animals of a kind it sees (cows/sheep with wheat, pigs with carrots/potatoes/beetroot, chickens with seeds), leading them towards its farm first when it has one nearby. Never feeds pets, named, leashed or fenced animals that are not on its own farm. Keeps seeds for replanting.

animal.description: which kind; default the best one it has food for

radius.description: how far to look for animals

lure.description: lead them to its farm first (when one is within 64 blocks)

maxHerd.description: do not breed a kind with this many adults around

catalog.name: find_target
catalog.description: Find something and report where it is: blocks and families (iron, diamonds, coal, logs, sand, water, lava), mobs (sheep, cows, villager), structures (village, nether portal, chest), biomes (desert, snow, ocean) or modded names. Looks at what is loaded around it, then remembered spots, then scouts a spiral on the surface by day (and can strip mine for ores). Remembers the spot as a place (found:iron for iron), reports coordinates, distance and direction from you, and comes back (or stays there with go). With bring it also fetches count of it and hands them over.

target.description: what to look for, e.g. iron, sheep, water, village, desert

radius.description: how far to search, in blocks

bring.description: also fetch some of it (blocks and items only) and hand it over

count.description: how many to bring

go.description: walk there and stay, instead of coming back to report

prospect.description: ores: strip mine for it when none is in sight (always on with bring)

catalog.name: bring_item
catalog.description: Bring a player some of an item: from the inventory, from my own chests (ones I placed or listed in settings.storage.chests, never anyone else's), by crafting it (simple recipes), by gathering it (chop, mine, harvest village or own farms), or by finding its source first. Then walks to the player, follows them if they move, tosses it to them and says how many they really got.

item.description: item name, e.g. oak_planks, bread, raw_iron, cobblestone

count.description: how many

player.description: who to give it to; default whoever asked

max_minutes.description: time for a search when it has to look for the source

catalog.name: fetch_drops
catalog.description: Go to where a player (default: whoever asked) died and bring their dropped items back, if the bot can get there before they despawn (5 minutes). Uses the death message and where it last saw them, or coordinates you give.

player.description: whose items; default whoever asked

x.description: where they died (with y and z), if the bot did not see it

try_anyway.description: go even when the items have probably despawned (they only age while the area is loaded)

catalog.name: chop_tree
catalog.description: Fell the nearest natural tree (any wood type): cut the logs it can reach, pick up the drops and plant a sapling. Crafts a wooden axe first if there is none and the inventory has the wood. Needs digging enabled. For "get N planks/logs" or materials for a build, prefer gather_materials, which chops as many trees as needed.

radius.description: how far to look for a tree, in blocks

replant.description: plant a sapling of the same kind afterwards if the bot has one

make_axe.description: craft a wooden axe first when there is none and there is wood for it

catalog.name: place_block
catalog.description: Place a block from the inventory at x y z. Needs a solid block next to that spot to build against.

item.description: block item to place, e.g. cobblestone

catalog.name: break_block
catalog.description: Break (mine) the block at x y z with the best tool in the inventory (crafts a pickaxe first for stone and ores when it can). Needs digging enabled. Refuses chests and other containers unless force=true.

catalog.name: build
catalog.description: Build a whole structure from a blueprint. For "build a house" use small_house (cozy 5x5 wooden house: log corners, pitched stair roof, windows, door, torches, crafting table, chest, bed if there is wool). Others: cottage (bigger 7x7 house on a cobblestone foundation with porch, glass windows, furnace), cabin (log cabin), watchtower (ladder, fenced platform), fortress (15x15 walled compound to put a house in), hut (plain box, quick), shelter (emergency 3x3 box around the bot), wall_segment, platform, tower. Picks a flat, clear spot near whoever asked (never in protected areas or over player builds), fills small dips, digs bumps and plants, faces the door to the player (or an open side), places blocks with the right facing (stairs, slabs, logs, doors, torches...), checks every block afterwards and fixes mistakes, and skips blocks that are already right, so calling it again resumes an interrupted build. gather=true first gathers what is missing. Reports blocks built and what was skipped. Learned blueprints (captured, imported, designed) build the same way; blueprint_pick chooses one when the request names none.

template.description: blueprint name: small_house (default house), cottage, cabin, watchtower, fortress, hut, shelter, wall_segment, platform, tower, or a learned one (blueprint_search finds them)

x.description: centre of the footprint; omit to pick a spot near the player

y.description: level of the floor (layer 0); default the ground there + 1

facing.description: side the entrance faces; default towards the player

material.description: main block, e.g. spruce_planks or cobblestone; default whatever fits that the bot has most of

theme.description: wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark_oak, mangrove, cherry, pale_oak; default whatever wood the bot has most of

gather.description: gather missing materials first (chop trees, mine, craft)

path.description: dig a short dirt path from the door afterwards when the bot can make a shovel

method.description: creative only: hand = place block by block like a player (default), commands = /fill and /setblock when the bot is op (fast; every command shows to other ops as an admin message), auto = the build.creativeMethod setting. Survival always builds by hand

replace.description: owners only: also dig up and replace blocks in the footprint that look player-made (e.g. an older build of ours being upgraded). Only when the owner asked to fix, upgrade or rebuild something there

catalog.name: build_plan
catalog.description: What a blueprint needs vs what the bot carries, and where it would go. preview=true adds a text drawing (top view and every layer). Without a template, lists the blueprints.

theme.description: wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark_oak, mangrove, cherry, pale_oak; default whatever wood the bot has most of

preview.description: include a text drawing of the structure

catalog.name: build_road
catalog.description: Plan and build a road with proper stairs between two places, like a person would: straight flights, stairs only on straight stretches (every stair facing up), flat landings at turns, switchbacks on steep slopes, a base filled down to the ground, head-room cut, wall railings where the drop beside it is 2 or more, never through buildings, trees or protected areas, joining existing roads at T-junctions. From the bot (or from_x/from_z, or `from` = a saved place or player) to x y z (or `to`). A point next to a door starts or ends straight out of that door. dry_run=true only plans and lists the materials. redo (a road id from road_list) builds a removed road again. Survival gathers stone bricks first; creative builds by hand or with commands.

x.description: target x

y.description: target walking height (default the ground there + 1)

to.description: target: a saved place name, a player name, or "me"

from.description: start: a saved place, a player, or "me" (default where the bot stands)

redo.description: id of a road built earlier (see road_list): build it again on the same line

width.description: lanes (1, 3 or 5; even widths round up); default the road.width setting (3)

palette.description: look: stone_bricks, cobblestone, stone, oak, spruce; default the road.palette setting (stone_bricks: stone brick floor and stairs, cobblestone base, stone brick wall railings)

lanterns.description: lanterns on posts at the landings (default the road.lanterns setting)

bridge.description: may cross water or lava on a deck

maxCut.description: deepest cut into the ground (default road.maxCut, 6; 0 without digging)

maxFill.description: highest fill above the ground (default road.maxFill, 6)

dry_run.description: only plan: length, stairs, landings, cut/fill and the materials needed

gather.description: survival: gather missing materials first (stone bricks are smelted and crafted from cobblestone)

method.description: creative only: hand (default, block by block) or commands (/fill and /setblock when op; every command shows to other ops)

catalog.name: connect_buildings
catalog.description: Join buildings with roads and stairs, cheapest roads first, each door getting a straight start, later roads joining earlier ones at T-junctions. Buildings come from: what the bot built (source=built, the default), doors among its own blocks (own), doors within radius of here (nearby), or door coordinates (doors="x y z; x y z"). Same road rules as build_road. dry_run=true only plans.

source.description: built: structures this bot finished with build; own: doors among blocks it placed; nearby: every door within radius; doors: the given coordinates

doors.description: door blocks as "x y z; x y z; ..." (source=doors)

radius.description: how far from here to look (built, own, nearby)

width.description: lanes (1, 3 or 5; even widths round up); default the road.width setting (3)

palette.description: look: stone_bricks, cobblestone, stone, oak, spruce; default the road.palette setting (stone_bricks: stone brick floor and stairs, cobblestone base, stone brick wall railings)

lanterns.description: lanterns on posts at the landings (default the road.lanterns setting)

bridge.description: may cross water or lava on a deck

maxCut.description: deepest cut into the ground (default road.maxCut, 6; 0 without digging)

maxFill.description: highest fill above the ground (default road.maxFill, 6)

dry_run.description: only plan: length, stairs, landings, cut/fill and the materials needed

gather.description: survival: gather missing materials first (stone bricks are smelted and crafted from cobblestone)

method.description: creative only: hand (default, block by block) or commands (/fill and /setblock when op; every command shows to other ops)

catalog.name: remove_road
catalog.description: Take out a road this bot built (road_list shows them): breaks the blocks it placed (only where they are still its blocks) and, in creative, puts back the ground it dug away. build_road with redo set to its id builds it again.

id.description: road id; default the last one built

restore.description: creative: put back the natural blocks that were dug out for it

method.description: creative only: hand (default) or commands (/fill when op)

catalog.name: road_list
catalog.description: The roads this bot built: id, from where to where, length, stairs, and whether it was removed.

catalog.name: blueprint_list
catalog.description: List the blueprints in the libraries (shipped, user folders, and the ones I learned: captured, imported, designed) with size, blocks, tags and main materials.

catalog.name: blueprint_search
catalog.description: Search the blueprint libraries by text, tags, material and size; best match first, with why it matched.

text.description: what is wanted, e.g. "small stone house" or "watchtower"

tags.description: house, defence, farm, decoration, or your own (a list, or comma separated)

material.description: a block it should use, e.g. cobblestone, spruce

catalog.name: blueprint_show
catalog.description: Show one blueprint: library info (author, source, tags, rating), a text drawing (top view and layers) and its materials vs my inventory. build_plan with the same template says where it would go.

catalog.name: blueprint_pick
catalog.description: Decide which blueprint to build for a request, following the building policy (config "building"): library = best saved match, creative = design a new one with blueprint_design (a saved match as fallback), ask = offer the owner 2-3 matches when they are online. Call it before build when the request does not name a blueprint.

text.description: the request, e.g. "a small house by the river"

tags.description: house, defence, farm, decoration, or your own (a list, or comma separated)

material.description: a block it should use, e.g. cobblestone, spruce

catalog.name: blueprint_import
catalog.description: Import a schematic file (Sponge/WorldEdit .schem, legacy MCEdit .schematic, Litematica .litematic, structure .nbt incl. Create, Axiom .bp; read by content) from the import folder into my learned blueprints (owners only). Refuses more than the block limit (default 4000) and suggests a crop.

file.description: file name inside the import folder (blueprints/import/ unless configured)

name.description: blueprint name (default: from the file name)

crop.description: keep only "x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2" (the file's own coordinates)

max_blocks.description: block limit for this import (default settings.build.importMaxBlocks, 4000)

air.description: false: empty space in the file is "don't care" instead of "must be clear"

terrain.description: false: ground cover the file carries from its surroundings (grass, paths, podzol, farmland) becomes dirt, plants, crops and leaves are left out

exact.description: keep the exact wood of wooden blocks (default: any wood, following the build theme)

facing.description: the side its entrance is on as drawn; default the side of the first door

tags.description: house, defence, farm, decoration, or your own (a list, or comma separated)

catalog.name: blueprint_capture
catalog.description: Save a build in the world as a learned blueprint (owners only), so it can be built again elsewhere: "save this as X". Give two corners (x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2), or a centre (x y z, default where the asking player stands) and a size. Keeps only player-made blocks unless all=true; the empty inside stays "must be clear". At most 32 per side.

name.description: name for the new blueprint (lowercase, digits, _)

x.description: centre instead of corners; y is the level of the floor

height.description: height from the floor up around the centre (default 10)

all.description: keep natural blocks (ground, plants, leaves) too

exact.description: keep the exact wood of wooden blocks (default: any wood, following the build theme)

facing.description: the side its entrance is on; default the side of the first door

tags.description: house, defence, farm, decoration, or your own (a list, or comma separated)

catalog.name: blueprint_design
catalog.description: Check and save a blueprint you designed, as YAML (or JSON) in the blueprint format (see blueprint_show small_house for an example): name, description, facing (entrance side), roles {name: {default: block, accept?: regex, kind?: block|door|attachment|furnish, optional?}}, palette {char: role | "role[facing=north]" | {block: oak_stairs, state: {...}}}, layers bottom to top, each a list of rows north to south, columns west to east; " " = don't care, "." = air, ^ v < > = stairs of the roof role. It is validated (format, size, real block names, every block placeable in order, nothing floating); problems come back so you can fix and call again. Data only, nothing runs.

yaml.description: the blueprint as YAML or JSON text

blueprint.description: the blueprint as an object instead of text

tags.description: house, defence, farm, decoration, or your own (a list, or comma separated)

overwrite.description: replace a learned blueprint of the same name

catalog.name: blueprint_delete
catalog.description: Delete one of my learned blueprints (captured, imported or designed). Owners only; shipped and user blueprints are never touched.

catalog.name: blueprint_rename
catalog.description: Rename one of my learned blueprints. Owners only.

catalog.name: gather_materials
catalog.description: Get the materials for a job in one go: chops as many trees as needed (crafting a wooden axe first), turns logs into planks and sticks, crafts wooden items (stairs, slabs, fences, doors, trapdoors, ladders, crafting tables, chests, tools), mines cobblestone with a pickaxe and other simple blocks, makes the stone family (cobblestone/stone/stone brick slabs, stairs and walls, stone bricks, smooth stone; smelting cobblestone into stone in a furnace), and tries for the extras: torches (coal, or charcoal smelted from logs), glass panes (sand smelted into glass), a bed (wool from sheep nearby). Extras it can't get are skipped and reported. Give either items, e.g. {"planks": 80, "door": 1} ("planks", "log", "door", "stairs", "slab", "fence", "bed" mean any wood/colour), or template="small_house" for everything a blueprint needs. Prefer this over many chop_tree/craft calls. Needs digging enabled to chop or mine.

template.description: blueprint name (see build_plan) to gather everything it needs

material.description: with template: the main block to use, e.g. spruce_planks or cobblestone

theme.description: wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, dark_oak...; default whatever wood the bot has most of

radius.description: how far to look for trees and blocks

catalog.name: upgrade_tools
catalog.description: Upgrade tools as far as possible right now: wooden pickaxe -> stone tools (mines the cobblestone) -> furnace from 8 cobblestone -> smelt iron (coal, or charcoal made from logs) -> iron tools -> diamond tools if it has diamonds. Covers pickaxe, axe, shovel and sword, armour optionally. Stops at the best tier it can reach and says what is missing (e.g. no iron ore seen). In creative it just takes the tools.

armour.description: also make iron armour once iron tools are done

kinds.description: tool kinds to upgrade; default pickaxe, axe, shovel, sword

prospect.description: when no iron ore is in sight, dig a staircase and strip mine to look for some

catalog.name: pickup_items
catalog.description: Walk over dropped items lying nearby to pick them up.

radius.description: how far to look for drops, in blocks

item.description: only pick up this item, e.g. oak_log; default everything

catalog.name: we_status
catalog.description: Is WorldEdit available on this server for me? Checks settings, the channels and registries the server announced, and if those say nothing asks the server with /we version. Also shows my selection, clipboard and limit.

refresh.description: ask the server again instead of the cached answer

catalog.name: we_select
catalog.description: Select a WorldEdit region (//pos1 and //pos2): two corners x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2, or a box around the asking player (or me): radius around them, height up from their feet. Owners only.

radius.description: around the player: blocks out from them on each side

height.description: around the player: from their feet up

down.description: around the player: blocks below their feet to include

catalog.name: we_set
catalog.description: Fill the selected WorldEdit region with a block pattern (//set). Owners only; refused over the block limit (worldedit.maxBlocks) or in protected areas.

pattern.description: block or WorldEdit pattern, e.g. stone_bricks, oak_planks, 50%stone,50%cobblestone, oak_stairs[facing=north]

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_replace
catalog.description: Replace one block (or mask) with another pattern in the selected region (//replace from to). Owners only; block limit and protected areas apply.

from.description: block or mask to replace, e.g. dirt, grass_block,dirt

to.description: block or pattern to put instead

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_walls
catalog.description: Build walls around the sides of the selected region (//walls), not floor or ceiling. Owners only; block limit and protected areas apply.

pattern.description: block or WorldEdit pattern, e.g. stone_bricks, oak_planks, 50%stone,50%cobblestone, oak_stairs[facing=north]

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_outline
catalog.description: Cover all six faces of the selected region (//faces, also known as //outline): walls, floor and ceiling. Owners only; block limit and protected areas apply.

pattern.description: block or WorldEdit pattern, e.g. stone_bricks, oak_planks, 50%stone,50%cobblestone, oak_stairs[facing=north]

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_hollow
catalog.description: Hollow out the objects in the selected region (//hollow), leaving a shell of the given thickness, inside filled with the pattern (default air). Owners only; block limit and protected areas apply.

pattern.description: what to fill the inside with

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_copy
catalog.description: Copy the selected region to the WorldEdit clipboard (//copy). The clipboard remembers where I stood: we_paste puts it back relative to where I stand then. Owners only.

catalog.name: we_cut
catalog.description: Cut the selected region to the WorldEdit clipboard (//cut): copies it and leaves air. Owners only; block limit and protected areas apply.

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_paste
catalog.description: Paste the WorldEdit clipboard (//paste) where I stand, or walk to x y z first. skip_air=true (-a) leaves existing blocks where the clipboard has air. Owners only; the clipboard size is checked against the block limit and protected areas first.

original.description: -o: paste where it was copied from, not where I stand

x.description: walk here first (where I stand is where the clipboard origin goes)

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_rotate
catalog.description: Rotate the WorldEdit clipboard around the vertical axis (//rotate), in steps of 90 degrees. Owners only.

catalog.name: we_flip
catalog.description: Flip (mirror) the WorldEdit clipboard (//flip) along a direction; default the way I face. Owners only.

catalog.name: we_undo
catalog.description: Undo my last WorldEdit change(s) (//undo). Owners only.

catalog.name: we_redo
catalog.description: Redo WorldEdit changes I undid (//redo). Owners only.

catalog.name: we_schem_list
catalog.description: List the schematics in the server's WorldEdit schematics folder (//schem list). Owners only.

catalog.name: we_schem_load
catalog.description: Load a schematic from the server's WorldEdit schematics folder into the clipboard (//schem load name), then we_paste puts it down. Only files already on the server; I can't upload any. Owners only.

catalog.name: we_schem_save
catalog.description: Save the WorldEdit clipboard as a schematic in the server's schematics folder (//schem save name). Owners only.

overwrite.description: -f: replace a schematic of that name

catalog.name: we_raw
catalog.description: Run one other WorldEdit command from a whitelist (size, count, distr, sel, desel, pos1, pos2, hpos1, hpos2, expand, contract, shift, outset, inset, chunk, clearclipboard, set, replace, walls, faces, outline, hollow, overlay, naturalize, smooth, center, centre, line, move, stack), e.g. "//expand 5 up" or "//stack 3 north". Commands that change blocks need a selection from we_select and stay under the block limit. Owners only.

command.description: the command with its arguments, e.g. "//expand 5 up"

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.name: we_build
catalog.description: Build a library blueprint with WorldEdit when an owner asks for it: if WorldEdit is available and the server already has a schematic with that name (//schem list), load and paste it (-a) at x y z (or where I stand); otherwise, or when that fails, build it the normal way (build). I can't upload schematics to the server. Owners only.

template.description: blueprint name (also the schematic name looked for on the server)

schematic.description: schematic name on the server if it differs from the blueprint name

fallback.description: build it normally when WorldEdit can't

gather.description: normal build: gather missing materials first

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

place.description: remembered place (or home) to farm near; default home, else here

x.description: farm near this x (with z) instead

size.description: plot side, odd, around one water block (9 = 80 farmland)

radius.description: how far from the centre to look for water

seeds.description: seeds to collect before planting (breaks grass until it has them or gives up)

fence.description: fence the plot when it has (or can craft) enough fences

light.description: put torches on the corners when it has torches or coal

spawnClearance.description: never farm within this distance of the world spawn

catalog.name: tend_farm
catalog.description: Look after its own farm (farm:1, farm:2...): put the water back if it is gone (with a bucket), plant bare farmland, till trampled dirt again and plant it, and grow the plot a ring at a time towards `size` around its water with the seeds it has, keeping `seedReserve` seeds for replanting. Use harvest for ripe crops. Needs digging enabled for tilling.

size.description: side of the square to grow the farm towards (one water block keeps 9x9 wet)

seedReserve.description: seeds kept for replanting: new cells only from seeds beyond these

maxCells.description: cells to plant or till at most this run

spawnClearance.description: never till within this distance of the world spawn

catalog.name: gather_seeds
catalog.description: Get seeds for a farm by breaking grass and ferns nearby (wheat seeds drop about 1 in 8) and picking them up. Keeps going, patch by patch out to the radius, until it has the seeds, the time is up or the grass runs out. Skips protected areas and the world spawn. Needs digging enabled.

count.description: seeds to get

radius.description: how far to look for grass

spawnClearance.description: never break grass this close to the world spawn

catalog.name: forage
catalog.description: Stopgap food from what grows wild nearby: pick ripe sweet berries (the bush stays), cut kelp at the shore without diving (smelt it into dried kelp later), and with apples=true break oak and dark oak leaves for apples (about 1 in 200) and pick up apples lying around. Never on protected land.

radius.description: how far to look

max.description: bushes or kelp stalks to take at most

apples.description: also break leaves for apples (slow, low odds: a last resort)

leaves.description: leaves to break at most for apples

catalog.name: breed
catalog.description: Breed two adult animals of a kind it sees (cows/sheep with wheat, pigs with carrots/potatoes/beetroot, chickens with seeds), leading them towards its farm first when it has one nearby. Never feeds pets, named, leashed or fenced animals that are not on its own farm. Keeps seeds for replanting.

animal.description: which kind; default the best one it has food for

radius.description: how far to look for animals

lure.description: lead them to its farm first (when one is within 64 blocks)

maxHerd.description: do not breed a kind with this many adults around

catalog.name: find_target
catalog.description: Find something and report where it is: blocks and families (iron, diamonds, coal, logs, sand, water, lava), mobs (sheep, cows, villager), structures (village, nether portal, chest), biomes (desert, snow, ocean) or modded names. Looks at what is loaded around it, then remembered spots, then scouts a spiral on the surface by day (and can strip mine for ores). Remembers the spot as a place (found:iron for iron), reports coordinates, distance and direction from you, and comes back (or stays there with go). With bring it also fetches count of it and hands them over.

target.description: what to look for, e.g. iron, sheep, water, village, desert

radius.description: how far to search, in blocks

bring.description: also fetch some of it (blocks and items only) and hand it over

count.description: how many to bring

go.description: walk there and stay, instead of coming back to report

prospect.description: ores: strip mine for it when none is in sight (always on with bring)

catalog.name: bring_item
catalog.description: Bring a player some of an item: from the inventory, from my own chests (ones I placed or listed in settings.storage.chests, never anyone else's), by crafting it (simple recipes), by gathering it (chop, mine, harvest village or own farms), or by finding its source first. Then walks to the player, follows them if they move, tosses it to them and says how many they really got.

item.description: item name, e.g. oak_planks, bread, raw_iron, cobblestone

count.description: how many

player.description: who to give it to; default whoever asked

max_minutes.description: time for a search when it has to look for the source

catalog.name: fetch_drops
catalog.description: Go to where a player (default: whoever asked) died and bring their dropped items back, if the bot can get there before they despawn (5 minutes). Uses the death message and where it last saw them, or coordinates you give.

player.description: whose items; default whoever asked

x.description: where they died (with y and z), if the bot did not see it

try_anyway.description: go even when the items have probably despawned (they only age while the area is loaded)

catalog.name: chop_tree
catalog.description: Fell the nearest natural tree (any wood type): cut the logs it can reach, pick up the drops and plant a sapling. Crafts a wooden axe first if there is none and the inventory has the wood. Needs digging enabled. For "get N planks/logs" or materials for a build, prefer gather_materials, which chops as many trees as needed.

radius.description: how far to look for a tree, in blocks

replant.description: plant a sapling of the same kind afterwards if the bot has one

make_axe.description: craft a wooden axe first when there is none and there is wood for it

catalog.name: place_block
catalog.description: Place a block from the inventory at x y z. Needs a solid block next to that spot to build against.

item.description: block item to place, e.g. cobblestone

catalog.name: break_block
catalog.description: Break (mine) the block at x y z with the best tool in the inventory (crafts a pickaxe first for stone and ores when it can). Needs digging enabled. Refuses chests and other containers unless force=true.

catalog.name: build
catalog.description: Build a whole structure from a blueprint. For "build a house" use small_house (cozy 5x5 wooden house: log corners, pitched stair roof, windows, door, torches, crafting table, chest, bed if there is wool). Others: cottage (bigger 7x7 house on a cobblestone foundation with porch, glass windows, furnace), cabin (log cabin), watchtower (ladder, fenced platform), fortress (15x15 walled compound to put a house in), hut (plain box, quick), shelter (emergency 3x3 box around the bot), wall_segment, platform, tower. Picks a flat, clear spot near whoever asked (never in protected areas or over player builds), fills small dips, digs bumps and plants, faces the door to the player (or an open side), places blocks with the right facing (stairs, slabs, logs, doors, torches...), checks every block afterwards and fixes mistakes, and skips blocks that are already right, so calling it again resumes an interrupted build. gather=true first gathers what is missing. Reports blocks built and what was skipped. Learned blueprints (captured, imported, designed) build the same way; blueprint_pick chooses one when the request names none.

template.description: blueprint name: small_house (default house), cottage, cabin, watchtower, fortress, hut, shelter, wall_segment, platform, tower, or a learned one (blueprint_search finds them)

x.description: centre of the footprint; omit to pick a spot near the player

y.description: level of the floor (layer 0); default the ground there + 1

facing.description: side the entrance faces; default towards the player

material.description: main block, e.g. spruce_planks or cobblestone; default whatever fits that the bot has most of

theme.description: wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark_oak, mangrove, cherry, pale_oak; default whatever wood the bot has most of

gather.description: gather missing materials first (chop trees, mine, craft)

path.description: dig a short dirt path from the door afterwards when the bot can make a shovel

method.description: creative only: hand = place block by block like a player (default), commands = /fill and /setblock when the bot is op (fast; every command shows to other ops as an admin message), auto = the build.creativeMethod setting. Survival always builds by hand

replace.description: owners only: also dig up and replace blocks in the footprint that look player-made (e.g. an older build of ours being upgraded). Only when the owner asked to fix, upgrade or rebuild something there

catalog.name: build_plan
catalog.description: What a blueprint needs vs what the bot carries, and where it would go. preview=true adds a text drawing (top view and every layer). Without a template, lists the blueprints.

theme.description: wood to build with: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark_oak, mangrove, cherry, pale_oak; default whatever wood the bot has most of

preview.description: include a text drawing of the structure

catalog.name: build_road
catalog.description: Plan and build a road with proper stairs between two places, like a person would: straight flights, stairs only on straight stretches (every stair facing up), flat landings at turns, switchbacks on steep slopes, a base filled down to the ground, head-room cut, wall railings where the drop beside it is 2 or more, never through buildings, trees or protected areas, joining existing roads at T-junctions. From the bot (or from_x/from_z, or `from` = a saved place or player) to x y z (or `to`). A point next to a door starts or ends straight out of that door. dry_run=true only plans and lists the materials. redo (a road id from road_list) builds a removed road again. Survival gathers stone bricks first; creative builds by hand or with commands.

x.description: target x

y.description: target walking height (default the ground there + 1)

to.description: target: a saved place name, a player name, or "me"

from.description: start: a saved place, a player, or "me" (default where the bot stands)

redo.description: id of a road built earlier (see road_list): build it again on the same line

width.description: lanes (1, 3 or 5; even widths round up); default the road.width setting (3)

palette.description: look: stone_bricks, cobblestone, stone, oak, spruce; default the road.palette setting (stone_bricks: stone brick floor and stairs, cobblestone base, stone brick wall railings)

lanterns.description: lanterns on posts at the landings (default the road.lanterns setting)

bridge.description: may cross water or lava on a deck

maxCut.description: deepest cut into the ground (default road.maxCut, 6; 0 without digging)

maxFill.description: highest fill above the ground (default road.maxFill, 6)

dry_run.description: only plan: length, stairs, landings, cut/fill and the materials needed

gather.description: survival: gather missing materials first (stone bricks are smelted and crafted from cobblestone)

method.description: creative only: hand (default, block by block) or commands (/fill and /setblock when op; every command shows to other ops)

width.description: lanes (1, 3 or 5; even widths round up); default the road.width setting (3)

palette.description: look: stone_bricks, cobblestone, stone, oak, spruce; default the road.palette setting (stone_bricks: stone brick floor and stairs, cobblestone base, stone brick wall railings)

lanterns.description: lanterns on posts at the landings (default the road.lanterns setting)

bridge.description: may cross water or lava on a deck

maxCut.description: deepest cut into the ground (default road.maxCut, 6; 0 without digging)

maxFill.description: highest fill above the ground (default road.maxFill, 6)

dry_run.description: only plan: length, stairs, landings, cut/fill and the materials needed

gather.description: survival: gather missing materials first (stone bricks are smelted and crafted from cobblestone)

method.description: creative only: hand (default, block by block) or commands (/fill and /setblock when op; every command shows to other ops)

catalog.name: remove_road

restore.description: creative: put back the natural blocks that were dug out for it

method.description: creative only: hand (default) or commands (/fill when op)

material.description: a block it should use, e.g. cobblestone, spruce

Call it before build when the request does not name a blueprint.

text.description: the request, e.g. "a small house by the river"

tags.description: house, defence, farm, decoration, or your own (a list, or comma separated)

material.description: a block it should use, e.g. cobblestone, spruce

catalog.description: Import a schematic file (Sponge/WorldEdit .schem, legacy MCEdit .schematic, Litematica .litematic, structure .nbt incl. facing.description: the side its entrance is on; default the side of the first door

tags.description: house, defence, farm, decoration, or your own (a list, or comma separated)

catalog.name: gather_materials

Extras it can't get are skipped and reported. Give either items, e.g. {"planks": 80, "door": 1} ("planks", "log", "door", "stairs", "slab", "fence", "bed" mean any wood/colour), or template="small_house" for everything a blueprint needs. catalog.description: Is WorldEdit available on this server for me? Checks settings, the channels and registries the server announced, and if those say nothing asks the server with /we version. Also shows my selection, clipboard and limit.

height.description: around the player: from their feet up

down.description: around the player: blocks below their feet to include

catalog.name: we_set
catalog.description: Fill the selected WorldEdit region with a block pattern (//set). Owners only; refused over the block limit (worldedit.maxBlocks) or in protected areas.

to.description: block or pattern to put instead

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

protected_ok.description: owners only: allow it inside a protected area or the spawn area, when the owner explicitly asked for that spot

catalog.description: Load a schematic from the server's WorldEdit schematics folder into the clipboard (//schem load name), then we_paste puts it down. Only files already on the server; I can't upload any. Owners only.

catalog.name: we_schem_save
catalog.description: Save the WorldEdit clipboard as a schematic in the server's schematics folder (//schem save name). Owners only.

catalog.description: Run one other WorldEdit command from a whitelist (size, count, distr, sel, desel, pos1, pos2, hpos1, hpos2, expand, contract, shift, outset, inset, chunk, clearclipboard, set, replace, walls, faces, outline, hollow, overlay, naturalize, smooth, center, centre, line, move, stack), e.g. "//expand 5 up" or "//stack 3 north".
